title: The Letter About Max
setting: A family house with stairs, a front door and a bedroom upstairs.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Max
characters.look: Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar)

sentences.en: Yesterday, Ben found a letter at the front door.
sentences.zh: 昨天，本在前门发现了一封信。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) picks up a white envelope from the mat at the front door of a house.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben finding the letter; 'yesterday' cannot be shown.
sentences.narration: Ben picks up a white envelope from the mat at the front door of a house.

sentence_targets.en: a written message sent to a person or organisation
The forward part or outward-facing surface of something.

sentences.en: He runs upstairs in his jeans and jacket.
sentences.zh: 他穿着牛仔裤和夹克跑上楼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), now wearing jeans and a jacket, runs up the stairs holding the envelope.
sentences.narration: Ben, now wearing jeans and a jacket, runs up the stairs holding the envelope.

sentence_targets.en: On or towards a higher floor of a building.
A short coat covering the upper body and arms.
Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.

sentences.en: "Is it about Max?" he asks Lily.
sentences.zh: “是关于麦克斯的吗？”他问莉莉。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) holds up the envelope and asks Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), who sits on her bed.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben asking Lily; the words are not shown.
sentences.narration: Ben holds up the envelope and asks Lily, who sits on her bed.

sentence_targets.en: say something to get information or an answer

sentences.en: Their pet was lost a month ago.
sentences.zh: 他们的宠物一个月前走丢了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) look sadly at an empty dog basket with a red ball in it.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the empty basket; 'a month ago' cannot be shown.
sentences.narration: Ben and Lily look sadly at an empty dog basket with a red ball in it.

sentence_targets.en: one of twelve yearly divisions, or roughly four weeks
An animal kept at home for company and pleasure.

sentences.en: Ben thinks it is bad news.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) looks worried as he holds the closed envelope; Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) bites her lip beside him.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben's worried face; the thought itself is not shown.
sentences.narration: Ben looks worried as he holds the closed envelope. Lily bites her lip beside him.

sentence_targets.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
To have an opinion or belief about something.

sentences.en: Something falls out: a photo of Max!
sentences.zh: 有东西掉了出来：是麦克斯的照片！
sentences.scene_prompt: A photo falls out of the open envelope onto the bed; Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) stare at it.
sentences.narration: A photo falls out of the open envelope onto the bed. Ben and Lily stare at it.

sentence_targets.en: A thing that is not named or specified.

sentences.en: In the photo, a strong farmer pats Max's head.
sentences.zh: 照片里，一位强壮的农民在拍麦克斯的头。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close-up of a photo: a strong farmer in a checked shirt pats the head of Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) in front of a barn.
sentences.narration: Close-up of a photo: a strong farmer in a checked shirt pats the head of Max in front of a barn.

sentence_targets.en: having great physical power or force
the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth

sentences.en: That night, a car stops, and Max jumps out!
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，一辆车停下，麦克斯跳了出来！
sentences.scene_prompt: At night, a farm truck stops outside the house and Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) jumps out towards Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) at the front door.
sentences.narration: At night, a farm truck stops outside the house and Max jumps out towards Ben and Lily at the front door.

sentence_targets.en: To end an activity or prevent something from happening.
The dark part of each day when the sun is down.
